_comment: Keats 44 source clusters -> 13 final thematic collections. Same label vocabulary as Dickinson (the graph already carries `cluster:` on every *(Keats).md work-note), but Keats has 140 works against Dickinson's 1764, so Dickinson's >=10-members rule collapses to a single cluster and cannot be reused. Finals are chosen for >=7 members each. A label mapped to itself is a final.
_comment_long_works: 6 works are excluded from the clusters and keep their own reading page under Long/: Endymion, Hyperion, The_Fall_of_Hyperion, Lamia (already atomized there) plus Otho_the_Great (101 KB verse drama) and The_Cap_and_Bells (41 KB). Burying a narrative poem of that size inside a thematic collection page would swamp the lyrics it sits with.
_comment_stars: The `Stars · Night · Military Camp` final was left with 6 members once its long works moved to Long/, one short of the >=7 target, so its night/sleep/dream poems are folded into the melancholy final -- To Sleep and Why did I laugh tonight belong there anyway.
_comment_greek_myth: The `Greek Mythology · Lust Sexual Desire · Desire` source cluster had only 4 members and loses Lamia to Long/, so its 3 survivors (La Belle Dame Sans Merci, Fragment of an Ode to Maia, Sonnet to the Nile) are folded into the mythic-visionary final rather than standing alone.
